qs.q: What is the big banner right under the header, with a headline and a main button, called?
qs.why: The hero is the first big message a visitor sees, usually above the fold.

opts: The part of the page you see without scrolling
qs.why: The name comes from newspapers: the top half of the front page shows when the paper is folded.

qs.q: A page should have several equally bold main buttons so visitors have lots of choice.
qs.why: One clear main call to action works best. Other buttons should look quieter.

qs.q: In the 60-30-10 rule, what is the 10% for?
opts: An accent color for the things you want clicked
qs.why: The accent is rare on purpose, so the main button and links stand out.

qs.q: What is the minimum contrast ratio WCAG asks for normal-size text?
qs.why: 4.5 : 1 for normal text, 3 : 1 for large text. 21 : 1 is black on white, the maximum.

qs.q: On a dashboard, where should the single most important number usually go?
qs.why: Eyes start top-left, so that's prime space for the key KPI.

qs.q: Which chart best shows how something changed over time?
qs.why: Line charts show trends at a glance.

qs.q: Why should a success message use a ✓ as well as green?
opts: Some people can't tell red and green apart
qs.why: Never rely on color alone. An icon or a word works for everyone.

qs.q: Which spacing values follow the 8-point grid?
qs.why: Multiples of 8 keep spacing consistent across a whole site.

qs.q: Which element should you use for something that does an action, like Like or Play?
qs.why: Buttons do things, links go places. Buttons also work with the keyboard and screen readers for free.

qs.q: Fill in the method that adds a class if it's missing and removes it if it's there.
qs.why: classList.toggle flips a class on and off, perfect for dark mode.
Characters 3 and 4 are ff, which is 255 in base 16.

qs.q: There are 4 slides and i is 3. What does this print?
qs.why: 4 % 4 is 0, so the slider wraps back to the first slide.

qs.q: What does e.preventDefault() do in a link's click listener?
opts: Stops the browser following the link the normal way
Opens the link in a new tab
qs.why: It cancels the default action, so your JavaScript can show the page instead.

qs.q: Which attributes should a link to another website get so it opens safely in a new tab?
qs.why: noopener stops the new page from reaching back into yours.

qs.q: Fill in the property that says how far the page has scrolled down.
qs.why: window.scrollY is the number of pixels scrolled from the top.

qs.q: The value of a range slider is a number, so you never need to convert it.
qs.why: Input values are always strings. Use Number() before doing math.
